guides.title: Search the archive and create a collection
guides.summary: Find indexed media and group selected assets without moving source files.
prerequisites: Archive and Collections must be enabled.
Sign in with permission to manage collections. Guest access does not grant collection editing.
The archive must contain indexed media.

steps.title: Search media
steps.instruction: Open Archive, enter a known indexed filename or term in Search media and submit the search.
steps.expected: Search results contain indexed media matching the submitted query; verify the asset names before selecting.

steps.title: Select and create
steps.instruction: Select the desired media using the asset selection control. Choose Add to collection, enter a Collection name under OR CREATE NEW, optionally enter purpose or handoff context, then choose Create and add.
steps.expected: The new collection is created with the selected assets.

steps.title: Verify membership
steps.instruction: Open Collections, open the newly named collection, and check that it contains the selected assets.
steps.expected: Collection members are visible; grouping does not move the source files.

expected: The selected media appears in the named collection without moving originals.
recovery: If the archive catalog cannot load, use Retry catalog when offered, then repeat the search.
If Create and add is disabled, check that Collection name is nonempty. Confirm collection-edit permission with the administrator.

guides.title: Download selected media
guides.summary: Prepare a browser download from selected archive media. This guide covers the remote method; drive and advanced transfers require separate qualification.
prerequisites: Archive remoteTransfer must be enabled and your signed-in account must have transfer permission.
Use Chrome or Edge on the destination device with a save-location picker.
Select media whose requested rendition is ready; missing renditions are not replaced with originals.

steps.title: Choose media and rendition
steps.instruction: Select archive media and choose Transfer. In Rendition choose an available Original, Web proxy, or Edit proxy when enabled.
steps.expected: The preview reports the requested and ready files. Missing renditions are identified.

steps.title: Prepare download
steps.instruction: Choose Download to this device, inspect the preview, then choose Prepare download.
steps.expected: Transfers opens with download preparation progress. Multiple ready files are packaged together.

steps.title: Choose a save location
steps.instruction: When the prepared transfer is ready, choose Choose save location and pick a destination file on this device. Wait for the save operation to finish.
steps.expected: The interface reports saving progress; the saved file is present at the location you selected.

expected: The selected ready renditions are saved to the chosen device location. Verify the finished save before using the file.
recovery: If the browser cannot open a save-location picker, open Media Nexus in Chrome or Edge.
If preparation failed or the prepared artifact expired, inspect the transfer error and use Prepare again after resolving the reported cause.
If saving was interrupted within the current session and Resume save is offered, use it to continue the save. Do not treat preparation as a completed download.

evidence.anchor: Missing renditions are never replaced with originals.
Open Media Nexus in Chrome or Edge on this device.

guides.title: Diagnose an interrupted transfer
guides.summary: Distinguish preparation failure from an interrupted browser save before choosing recovery.
prerequisites: Archive remote download and transfer-edit permission must be enabled.
You must be able to open the relevant transfer record in Transfers.

steps.title: Inspect the transfer
steps.instruction: Open Transfers, find the affected record using Search transfer history, and expand its summary. Record its mode, status, progress, artifact readiness and displayed error.
steps.expected: Transfer details expose the reported error and file status. Preparation and downloaded byte counts are shown separately.

steps.title: Choose the supported recovery
steps.instruction: For failed, cancelled, interrupted or expired remote preparation, resolve the displayed cause and use Prepare again. For a partial browser save, use Resume save when offered. If Source version required is displayed, start a new transfer with the producer's full size and SHA-256 as instructed.
steps.expected: Preparation and save controls match the reported condition. A source-version error is not treated as a resumable completed source.

steps.title: Verify recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the prepared artifact to be ready, choose a save location, and verify that the save finishes. If the error remains, retain the record and seek support with the transfer identifier and sanitized error.
steps.expected: A ready artifact and completed local save are separate checks. An unresolved error remains a support case.

expected: Recovery uses the control for the observed failure stage; a prepared artifact alone does not establish a completed device download.
recovery: For missing derivatives, generate the missing proxy type only when that action is offered and you have processing permission. Reinspect the transfer before preparing again.
Do not remove a failed record before preserving the identifier and sanitized error for support.
